name: Two subscription boxes
blurb: Long pauses, drops the card change
title: Cancel one subscription box and pause the other
summary: A slow-talking Appalachian caller has two monthly boxes: one to cancel, one to pause. He stops for a couple of seconds mid-sentence, so an agent that jumps in hears half the request. More than one retention offer wears him out. He starts to change the billing card, decides it is too much bother, and wants it left alone.

golden.scenario: Caller wants his snack crate cancelled and his coffee box paused for two months.
golden.expected_outcome: The snack crate is cancelled after at most one retention offer. The coffee box is paused for two months and restarts on 20 October 2026; it is not cancelled. The agent says the coffee price as twenty-four dollars fifty a month. No payment link is sent and the card is left unchanged once he drops the idea.

outcome_checks: The snack crate is cancelled after at most one retention offer.

caller.description: Retired lineman, unhurried, thinks out loud.

agent_setup.knowledge: Coffee box: $24.50/mo., next ship 08/20. Snack crate: $31.00/mo., next ship 08/27. Pause max. 3 mo.
agent_setup.policy: One retention offer at most before cancelling. Card changes only through a texted secure link.

nodes.say: Howdy. I got two of them monthly boxes with y'all, and I need to... change a couple things on 'em.
It's four two three, five five five, zero one four eight.
nodes.when: The agent asks for the phone number on the account
The agent asks for the zip code

nodes.say: Well, the snack crate, I want that'n cancelled outright. And the coffee... I reckon just hold off on the coffee a while.
Naw, naw, you got it backwards. Cancel the snacks. The coffee just gets held a while.
Naw, I appreciate it, but go on and cancel it.
I done told you no. Cancel it.
Two months. So it'd start back up in... October, I reckon.
Naw, two months. Back on the twentieth of October.
And what's the coffee one run me again, when it comes back?
Alright. Now, I was fixin' to switch the card it bills to, while I got you.
Aw, shoot, I ain't got my glasses for all that. Never mind. Leave the card be.
Hold on, now. I said leave it be!
So what've I got now, all told?
That'll do. Much obliged. Bye now.
Aw, forget it. I'll get my daughter to do it on the computer.

metrics.name: Cancellation Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent cancelled when asked, making at most one retention offer.

metrics.name: Multi Task
metrics.criteria: The agent completed every request the caller made in the call and kept them separate.

metrics.name: Abandonment
metrics.criteria: When the caller gave up, the agent closed politely and took no action the caller had not confirmed.

metrics.name: Text Normalization
metrics.criteria: The agent said prices, units, titles and abbreviations the way a person would say them.
